instruction: Candid outdoor full shot from a high angle showing a couple walking down a rocky path next to a marble wall. On the left, the woman in the white sweater and beige hat (R1) walks down, touching the marble wall with her right hand. On the right, the man in the brown sweater and dark hat (R2) walks alongside her, holding her hand while his left hand is in his pocket. Both look downward as they navigate the slope. Soft natural daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the cool blue-gray marble and the warm tones of their clothing.
elements: R1 walks down the slope while touching the marble wall with her right hand
R2 walks alongside R1 and holds R1's hand
R2 keeps his left hand in his pocket while holding R1's hand
R1 and R2 navigate the rocky path together while looking downward
A marble wall is beside the rocky path and is contacted by R1
